# --description--

You can compare an optional with `nil` using `==` and `!=`, and you can compare it directly with a plain value of the wrapped type:
```swift
var score: Int? = 10
print(score == nil) // false
print(score == 10)  // true
```
Remember that `Int?` and `Int` are two different types: an `Int?` may be empty, an `Int` never is.

# --instructions--

Declare an optional `String` variable `nickname` without a value, and an optional `Int` variable `score` holding `10`

# --before-seed--

```swift
// DO NOT EDIT FROM HERE

    _testCount += 1
    if !assertion {
        _testFailedCount += 1
        print("Test Case '--err-t\(_testCount)--' failed")
    }
}
// DO NOT EDIT UNTIL HERE
```

# --asserts--

`nickname` must be `nil`

```swift
tryCatch(nickname == nil)
```

`nickname` must be an optional `String`

```swift
tryCatch(type(of: nickname) == String?.self)
```

`score` must be equal to `10`

```swift
tryCatch(score == 10)
```

`score` must be an optional `Int`

```swift
tryCatch(type(of: score) == Int?.self)
```

# --after-asserts--

print("Executed \(_testCount) tests, with \(_testFailedCount) failures")
